title: Hard hitting Daylen Everette is a bet on development for the Steelers

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Hard hitting Daylen Everette is a bet on development for the Steelers
sources.description: Few players in recent Georgia football history have been by turns as exhilarating and maddening to watch as Daylen Everette. I’m happy for Pittsburgh Steelers fans to witness first hand exactly what I mean now that the Norfolk, Virginia product is headed to the Steel City. Everette projects as something of a developmental prospect, but […]
